name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=chapter_intro_menu, descriptor=input_loop). No address residue. Accurately describes the function: a blocking input dispatch loop for the chapter-intro 4-way menu. Shared by all 3 chapter-intro menu variants (main/typeB/typeC).
purpose: Chapter-intro 4-way menu input loop: blocks reading scancodes, moves the cursor left/right (with 0..3 wrap), and returns when the user commits (1) or cancels (-1).
logic_summary: result=0; loop: scancode = fd2_wait_input_with_chapter_dialog_blink(0) (blinks dialog cursor while waiting). Dispatch on scancode: 0x4B (Left) -> play cursor chime, cursor--, wrap (int)cursor<0 -> 3; 0x4D (Right) -> play cursor chime, cursor++, wrap (int)cursor>3 -> 0; 0x1C (Enter) or 0x39 (Space) -> result=1; 0x01 (Esc) -> result=-1; otherwise keep looping. while (result==0); return result. Has the __CHK(0x14) stack-probe prologue. The wrap bound tests are signed (JGE/JLE in asm), so the unsigned cursor global is cast to int in src; matches the disassembly.

returns.semantics: 1 = user committed (Enter/Space); -1 = user cancelled (Esc). Never returns 0 (the loop continues while result==0). Caller treats (ret & 0xff)==1 as commit.
